sheets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent isometric city-game vehicle sheet. EXACT regular 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 isolated complete sprites. Camera orthographic looking down 30 degrees, projected road diagonals have 2:1 horizontal/vertical ratio. Match realistic hand-painted architectural city sprites, no pixel art, no cartoon outlines. Every vehicle's painted BODY must be saturated MAGENTA/PINK for offline palette recoloring; keep windows neutral charcoal, tires black, headlights ivory and trim neutral silver. No blue/pink glass, no logos, no text. 15 percent transparent margin inside every equal cell; no touching or overlap. Genuine transparent alpha, no road, no ground, no grid, no labels, no cast shadows beyond a tiny contact shadow. All four columns show the SAME model: column1 front toward LOWER RIGHT, column2 front toward LOWER LEFT, column3 rear facing viewer with nose toward UPPER LEFT, column4 rear facing viewer with nose toward UPPER RIGHT. Correct visible front/headlamps or rear/taillamps, consistent sizes. Designed to be readable reduced to 28 pixels wide. Row1 compact rounded three-door hatchback. Row2 ordinary four-door family sedan. Row3 long station wagon. Row4 boxy small delivery van. Original generic designs, no brands.
